title: Port old USB-PTP dissector
description:
This is a port of the USB-PTP dissector started in #8431.
The code is mostly verbatim, with fixes to handle 9 years of development
in the interim.

Reasons it's WIP:
 - [x] Make the 'masked' string-value type private
 - [x] Need to check the update script. Both to get a decade of updates and
   to turn it from 'semi-manual' to 'automatic'.
 - [ ] Containers spanning multiple URBs should be together.
 - [ ] "TODO: Android"

I am not sure if this extension of a value_string is generic enough to add to proto.h and value_string.h.

If it was, we'd want to add methods to common modules for them too to make its usage more like value_string. Would be happy to hear other opinions, but I think maybe this ought to be specific to this dissector at least for now?

Looks like masked_values only really work by a quirk of padding. Certain places still interpret it as a `value_string` and if you eg. try filtering a field of this type with a string ("usb-ptp.device.operationssupported == OpenSession"), it'll erroneously test it against the mask value and show no matches (as compared to "== 0x1001", which works). This is ignoring that it's completely busted on 32-bit builds, but those aren't supported.

I don't think the concept of masked values is generally applicable everywhere. I can switch this to CF_FUNC and lose filtering off enum strings without much issue (it's already broken, heh). Long term, a way to have custom functions for full functionality besides just formatting would be both suitable here and broadly applicable, but I'm not nearly versed enough to do that.

commits_data.title: Update perl script and fetch from libgphoto2
commits_data.message:
Update perl script and fetch from libgphoto2

 - Perl script is now automatic and idempotent
 - Rerun with the latest ptp.h from libgphoto2 git
 - Added 4 new flavors

commits_data.title: Make the 'masked_string_value' type private
commits_data.message:
Make the 'masked_string_value' type private

In addition to not being applicable everywhere, the places that 'just
worked' by being close-enough to a value_string were sketchy
and broken in the places that actually got a benefit from not being
NULL.

Example:
 - "usb-ptp.device.operationssupported == 0x1002" -> results
 - "usb-ptp.device.operationssupported == OpenSession" -> broken
